answer_1.quote: We fine-tune the modified models on the Dolly-15k instruction-following dataset ... and evaluate their performance on 5 conversational datasets: Dolly (DL, 500 testing samples from Dolly-15k), Self-Instruct (SI), Vicuna (VC), Super-Natural Instructions (SN), and Unnatural Instruction (UI).

answer_2.quote: In addition to the ROUGE-L (R-L) scores, which measure the longest common sub-sequence between generated and reference answers, we also evaluate all answers to the queries using DeepSeek-V3 to provide feedback scores ranging from 0 to 10.
